name: Mega Flex Plastics Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2003, Mega Flex Plastics
 Ltd is in the business of manufacturing 
Leno bags[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) Leno Bags:[2]
Leno bags are a cost-effective, water
 and moisture resistant for packing, storing 
& preserving vegetables like potato, onion, 
 ginger, garlic, cabbage etc. and fruits like pineapple, citrus fruits, raw mango, coco
nut etc. The Leno bags have widths 
between 20 cm to 72 cm
b) Polypropylene Woven Fabric:[3]
It is a lightweight, strong, and resistant 
to chemicals used as an essential component 
 in agriculture, packaging, and construction
c) Twisted Sutli:[4]
It is manufactured from Polypropylene 
 Granules and are mainly used for tying and stitchin bags

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.52% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.54 Cr.
